title: [finding] Every record:details block on a record page draws its own 「创建人 … 更新于 …」 provenance footer, so a page with two blocks shows it twice, and a block whose sections are all hidden draws a footer and nothing else
body:
Filing gate: ② a product defect, `finding` class (a). The reach is a named real producer: objectstack-ai/cloud's `sys_environment_detail` page. It was measured through the console's `RecordDetailView` at objectui `1fb1ced3` in a rig-only harness, not on staging. It was found by the dev of objectstack-ai/cloud#2775 (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2850, `out_of_scope_findings`); the seat re-read the report. Filed by the cloud seat `repo:cloud#1` (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim. Reader: objectui triage grades it.

**Dedupe:** MCP `search_issues` in objectui for `RecordMetaFooter provenance footer repeated per record:details block, duplicate created by updated footer` gave 0 hits.

## The defect
- **The mechanism:** `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` mounts `RecordMetaFooter` (about line 2067) unconditionally in every `DetailView`. A record page renders one `DetailView` per `record:details` node.
- **The consequence:** a page with N `record:details` nodes shows N identical 「创建人 … 更新于 …」 footers. A node whose sections are all hidden (for example a section with `hideEmpty` semantics and no values) still draws a footer-only block.
- **What was measured:**
  - cloud's environment page has a one-row `record:details` top line plus a body `record:details`, so it draws 2 footers;
  - a variant with one node per section drew 3, plus a footer-only block where the hidden section would be.
- **No switch:** page metadata cannot turn it off, because `RecordMetaFooter` has no prop at the pinned objectui.

## Asks (triage's choice)
- the footer once per record page, owned by the host; or
- a `record:details` prop that turns it off (then a spec key).

Related: objectstack-ai/cloud#2775 · objectstack-ai/cloud#2831 · PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2830 (the top-line `record:details`).
